clauses.requirement: After undergoing the tests referred to in paragraph 5.1.3.1 (test procedure for Class IA and IB retro-reflectors), the retro-reflectors in each group shall meet the requirements of paragraphs 5.1.3.2.1 and 5.1.3.2.2.
After undergoing the tests referred to in paragraph 5.1.3.1, the retro-reflectors in each group shall have a colour which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.5.

After undergoing the tests referred to in paragraph 5.1.3.1, the retro-reflectors in each group shall have an RI which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.4; the verification shall be performed only for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle of β1 = β2 = 0° or, if necessary, in all positions specified in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1 and 1.2.
Class IA and IB retro-reflectors shall meet the minimum values of the coefficient of luminous intensity RI of retro-reflection as specified in paragraph 5.1.4 and its sub-paragraphs.

When applying for approval, the applicant shall specify one or more axes of reference, or a range of axes of reference, corresponding to the illumination angle β1 = β2 = 0° in the table of coefficients of luminous intensity RI.

Where the manufacturer specifies more than one axis of reference or a range of different axes of reference, the photometric measurements shall be repeated, each time referring to a different axis of reference or to the extreme axis of reference of the range specified by the manufacturer.

For photometric measurements of the retro-reflector, only the illuminating surface defined by the planes contiguous to the outermost parts of the optical system of the retro-reflective device, as indicated by the manufacturer and contained within a circle of 200 mm diameter for Class IA or IB, shall be considered; the illuminating surface shall be limited to 100 cm2, though the surfaces of the retro-reflecting optical units need not attain this area; the manufacturer shall specify the perimeter of the area to be used.
The Class IA and Class IB retro-reflector shall meet the minimum RI values of retro-reflection specified for Class IA and Class IB under paragraph 5.1.4.
